content: sops-nix multi-host best practices (Mic92/sops-nix README + frankper the-one-nix, MarkusBitterman/HALLway, nicolkrit999, unmovedcentre, pvv-nixos-config, dev.to noorlatif): .sops.yaml at repo root with YAML anchors keys: (&admin personal age key, &hostname per host); creation_rules use path_regex so admin key + that host's key decrypt host secrets, admin-only for user editing, all keys for shared/common secrets. Admin/recovery age key on workstation is the escape hatch and MUST be included in every rule (frankper, HALLway). Per-host keys: age-keygen on host OR derive from SSH host key via ssh-to-age (ssh host key exists on every NixOS box; ed25519 only). Pitfalls: (1) after adding a host you MUST sops updatekeys on every secrets file that host needs - file headers don't update automatically; (2) moving a secrets file between dirs does NOT re-encrypt - run updatekeys; (3) key_groups list syntax - a stray '-' before subsequent key types switches sops into Shamir split requiring multiple keys - breaks sops-nix; (4) sops -r rotates inner key only, it is NOT updatekeys; (5) ssh host key rotation breaks boot-time decryption unless rekeyed; (6) new-host chicken-and-egg: key must exist before secrets can decrypt - common pattern = provision new host with placeholder/secrets-encrypted-for-admin-only, first boot generates host key, then add to .sops.yaml, updatekeys, rebuild (frankper enableSops=false bootstrap, HALLway rekey-from-workstation flow).
